content: Stripe's hosted Customer Portal (billingPortal.sessions.create) handles plan changes, payment method updates, invoice history, and cancellation without custom UI; sessions are short-lived, created on-demand per visit, and configured/customized via the Dashboard's portal configuration (which subscriptions/actions are exposed). The alternative is building a custom account page against the Billing API directly (list subscriptions, update payment method via Elements/SetupIntent, cancel via API) which requires far more code, PCI-scope UI, and ongoing maintenance for edge cases Stripe already solves (proration, tax, dunning).
